title: Source-backed OMR performance statistics

policy_key.1850_holdout: baseline, b651 prior, and c291 current

development120.comparison: against final-a17498fc863d; all 120 songs are JPK development/diagnostic material
development120.limits: Reference editions differ. These scores are disagreement measures, not recognition accuracy or cross-book validation.

expanded52.scope: 52 source crops, 26 matched tunes per printing, both layout variants; original pilot14 crops are included within these 52 (7 tunes per book).
expanded52.source_review: The b651 filter rejected one genuine damaged Aylesbury 186 head, confirmed 10 non-head boxes, and leaves one Kedron 219 localization case ambiguous.

1860_b651_vs_c291.interpretation: The revised rule's observed cost is retaining four artifact interpretations (eight layout occurrences), with +7 PD edits overall and slightly lower F1. This sample does not exercise new genuine-head protection.

1850.scope: 6 complete tunes on 4 pages, 12 layout configurations; 3 likely damaged primary heads and 1 disputed secondary head
1850.primary_damaged_heads_surviving: 3/3 in baseline, b651, and c291, in both layouts
1850.disputed_secondary_head: Lenox hollow oval survives all stages; excluded from primary denominator
1850.intact_controls: 7/8 emitted as notes; Lenox C1 hollow triangle is misclassified as rest by every stage
1850.coverage_gaps: Only oval/square damage appears; small sample. Distress has a baseline two-of-three-staff layout failure. Survival shows no rescue benefit and does not establish broad transfer or complete source accuracy.

southern_harmony.screening: 80 available music pages reviewed (printed pages 1-30 and 33-82; printed pages 31-32 absent). This source screen supplied the selected severe four-shape sample.

selected_severe_sample.serialized_note_survival: 6/10 severe heads become notes in baseline, b651 prior, and c291 current, with identical survival in both layouts; triangle 1/2, oval 2/2, square 1/3, diamond 2/3.
selected_severe_sample.coverage_gaps: Shortfalls: one additional oval and one additional triangle to reach three per shape; moderate diamond 0/3; limited fill/shape combinations. System grouping incorrect in 6/8 tunes. This enriched source sample does not establish broad accuracy or generalization.

southern_harmony.interpretation: This is the 1835 Southern Harmony source used by the severe-four-shape holdout, not an 1850 printing. The run explicitly says the source screen is not evidence that other qualifying heads are absent.

1850_screening.interpretation: No qualifying heads were found in this 300-page expansion; this is distinct from the Southern Harmony sample and does not provide a survival metric.

severe_four_shape_southern_1835.scope: 8 complete tunes on six Southern Harmony pages; 19 primary damaged heads total, including 10 severe heads across four shapes; 38 intact controls and five ambiguous objects.
severe_four_shape_southern_1835.primary_damaged_heads_serialized_as_note: 6/10 severe heads, same in baseline, b651 and c291 and both layouts; triangle 1/2, oval 2/2, square 1/3, diamond 2/3
severe_four_shape_southern_1835.coverage_gaps: Missing third severe oval/triangle slots, all moderate diamonds, several intact-control cells and severe fill/shape combinations. Six of eight tunes have incorrect system grouping in both layouts.
severe_four_shape_southern_1835.interpretation: The selected source-first sample is from Southern Harmony (1835), not 1850 Sacred Harp. No newly exercised revised-abstention rescue; four severe cases fail to serialize as notes in every stage. These observed cases are not a fresh holdout.

proposed_cohort_arithmetic.unit_warning: 85 counts edition-crops, not independent tunes or statistically independent observations. The 14 pilot crops are already part of expanded52 and must not be added again; layout variants and policy stages are repeated observations.

brief_notes: Keep the policy identities separate: expanded52 compares final-a17498fc863d to b651; 1860 compares b651 to c291.
PD edit distance is lower-is-better disagreement against edition-different MusicXML references; F1 is time-aware exact-event F1.
Expanded52 reports 16 timing-failure configurations total (14 default, 2 clean_layout), identical across prior/current; failures remain included.
Do not describe the 1860 retained artifacts as head loss: c291 abstained on them and emitted them; they were reviewed as artifacts/extra interpretations.
The severe four-shape holdout is from Southern Harmony, catalogued 1835 (1835-Southern-Oberlin-IA); a separate 300-page 1850 Sacred Harp screen found zero qualifying heads.
